nuggets.text: Todd Bowles went undrafted, then started at free safety for Washington's Super Bowl XXII win over Denver.
Todd Bowles left Temple without a degree and finally earned his bachelor's in 2023, from Mount St. Mary's University.
Todd Bowles has won his season opener in each of his first four seasons as the Buccaneers head coach.
The Buccaneers have won five straight season openers, tied with the Eagles for the NFL's longest active streak.
Baker Mayfield is 3-0 in Week 1 as the Buccaneers starter, with nine touchdown passes and zero interceptions.
Baker Mayfield is three touchdown passes shy of 200 in his regular-season career.
Baker Mayfield was the first Heisman winner to start college as a walk-on since scholarships began in the 1950s.
Baker Mayfield is on his 11th playcaller in nine NFL seasons, with Zac Robinson now calling plays for the Buccaneers.
The Buccaneers were the first team to play in and win a Super Bowl at their own home stadium, in Super Bowl LV.
Baker Mayfield just signed a franchise-record contract extension with the Buccaneers.
